description_en: Retrieves the sensitive data identification results from Data Security Guard
description_zh: 该接口用于获取数据保护伞的敏感数据识别结果
kebab_example: aliyun dataworks-public dsg-query-sens-result --tenant-id 10241024 --db-type ODPS.ODPS --project-name project --schema-name schema --table table --col col --node-name Personal_information --level 3 --sens-status 1 --sensitive-id 10241024 --sensitive-name name --order DESC --order-field gmt_create --page-no 1 --page-size 10 --start-date 2026-05-19 --end-date 2026-05-19 --api-version 2020-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DsgQuerySensResult

parameters.help_en: The tenant ID. Log on to the DataWorks console (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console), go to the DataStudio page, click the username in the upper-right corner, and choose Menu > User Info to obtain the tenant ID
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID。您可登录DataWorks控制台 (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)，进入数据开发（DataStudio）页面，单击右上方当前登录用户名称，选择菜单 > 用户信息，获取租户ID
parameters.name: tenant_id

parameters.help_en:
The database type. Valid values:
ODPS.ODPS
HOLO.POSTGRES
EMR
parameters.help_zh:
数据库类型，取值为：
ODPS.ODPS
HOLO.POSTGRES
EMR
parameters.name: db_type

parameters.help_en: The name of the DataWorks workspace. Log on to the DataWorks console (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console) and go to the workspace configuration page to obtain the workspace name
parameters.help_zh: DataWorks工作空间的名称。您可以登录DataWorks控制台 (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)，进入工作空间配置页面获取工作空间名称
parameters.name: project_name

parameters.help_en: The sensitivity level of the field
parameters.name: level

parameters.help_en:
The sensitivity status of the field. Valid values:

sensitive: sensitive.
noIdentify: not identified.
noResult: no result
parameters.help_zh:
字段敏感状态：

sensitive：敏感
noIdentify：未识别
noResult：无结果
parameters.name: sens_status

parameters.help_en: The ID of the sensitive field
parameters.name: sensitive_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the sensitive field
parameters.name: sensitive_name

parameters.help_en:
The sort order. Valid values:
DESC: descending.
ASC: ascending
parameters.help_zh:
排序方式：
DESC：降序。
ASC：升序
parameters.name: order

parameters.help_en:
The field used for sorting. Valid values:
gmt_create
gmt_modified
parameters.help_zh:
用于排序的字段：
gmt_create
gmt_modified
parameters.name: order_field

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 每页显示的条数，默认为10条，最大为20条
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The query start time in the format of yyyy-MM-dd or yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss
parameters.help_zh: 查询开始时间，格式为yyyy-MM-dd或者yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss
parameters.name: start_date

parameters.help_en: The query end time in the format of yyyy-MM-dd or yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间，格式为yyyy-MM-dd或者yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss
parameters.name: end_date

DynamicErrorCode.description_en: The error code. The value is the same as ErrorCode

DynamicErrorMessage.description_en: The error message. The value is the same as ErrorMessage

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. It is a unique identifier for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID，一次请求的唯一标识

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful. Valid values:
true: successful.
false: failed
Success.description_zh:
调用是否成功。
true：成功。
false：失败
